effects.printed_clause: Conditional hand Special Summon, then ICE Special Summon lock for rest of turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Hand procedure checks empty own field or Dragon Xyz and registers CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON for ICE through End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Kashtira Fenrir supplies conditional hand procedure/post-procedure restriction structure.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from a Stellaer Xyz to activate an effect: Special Summon a Stellaer monster from hand.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_MOVE now catches detachment to the GY or banishment; the condition verifies REASON_COST and a Stellaer Xyz activating handler before Special Summoning from hand.

official_references.matched_structure: Gagaga Ganbara Knight is the official detached-to-activate trigger analogue.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: EVENT_TO_GRAVE missed redirected detachment. Official Gagaga Ganbara Knight uses EVENT_MOVE for the same printed trigger.

effects.printed_clause: Banish that summoned monster when it leaves field.
effects.lua_implementation: Successful summoned monster receives LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT to banishment with standard redirect reset.

official_references.matched_structure: Special Summon from hand or GY, then apply a leave-field redirect that banishes the summoned monster.

effects.printed_clause: The detached effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.

coverage_override.reason: The summon procedure and its resulting Attribute lock are one procedure record; the detached summon, leave-field redirect, and its HOPT are represented by the remaining records.
